description: §4.12 + §4.12.2 (S445 control) — a `<program name="svc" auth="required">` inside the application `<program>` through a `<div>` has a `<program>` ancestor, so it is NESTED and its `auth=` is E-PROGRAM-NESTED-AUTH. The wrapper `<div>` does not make it top-level (so it is not an E-PROGRAM-002 second program either) — a `<program>` may sit anywhere (locality of behaviour), and markup between it and its ancestor program never changes its role.
rationale: §4.12 (S445): 'It's nested if it has one [a `<program>` or `<page>` ancestor]. Wrapper `<div>`s never change a program's role.' §4.12.2: an `auth=` on a nested `<program>` SHALL be a compile error (`E-PROGRAM-NESTED-AUTH`).
